sketchMechanisms: Optional chaining — accessing a property through a chain of optionals returns nil and silently stops evaluation the moment any link is absent
In Lua, table indices start at 1, and accessing index 0 returns nil — the zeroth position simply does not exist
The 'never' type represents values that can never occur; a function returning 'never' cannot return at all, and a variable of type 'never' cannot be assigned anything
